lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Say...

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Has anyone seen Cocorella today?
Cocowhat now?
Have you lost your umbrella?

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: My black umbrella.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: I lost it at some point while I was outside.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: I can't find it anywhere.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: When I got back, it was missing, and now I can't find it.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Why don't you retrace your steps?

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: We'll all put our heads together and see if we can come up with anything.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Let's see...

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: The first thing I did was go to the toy store to see Mica and Belorta.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Then I went to the comic book store in Talentum Mall.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Then to the Commander's Room to hang out with Master.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: And finally, I did a shift at the Maid Cafe before heading home.
Quite the busy schedule.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Any self-respecting maid never spends her time idly.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: What was that about Cocorella?

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: It's gone missing?

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: I'm passing by the toy store right now.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: I'll pop in and have a look.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: I'm here cleaning the Maid Cafe. I'll check around here.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: In that case,

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: I'll head over to the Talentum Mall.
Leave the Commander's Room to me.
I rummage through the Commander's Room for a long time.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: The staff at the toy store said they haven't seen anything.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: It doesn't seem to be in the cafe either.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Maybe someone thought it was theirs and took it by mistake?

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: This can't be happening!

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: No sign of it at the comic book shop, either.
I think I found it.
For reasons that elude me, the umbrella was in the trash can.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Awesome!

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: I figured Master would be the one to find it.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: You're the best Master! I'm not worthy!
Having said that, now might not be the best time to bring it to you.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Why not?
Cocorella positively reeks at the moment.
Cocorella also needs some time alone.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Did Cocorella fart?

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Did Cocorella... wet the bed?
What the... no.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Then I'm afraid I'll have to insist it is returned at once.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Cocoa.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Have some faith.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: I'm sure there's a reason Master doesn't want to return Cocorella yet.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Fine.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: I'll wait,

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: but only because I'm a professional.
It should only take a day or so.
I will wash the umbrella before returning it to Cocoa.
